newsitem.title: USA: US Semiconductor group plans book-to-bill Tuesday.
newsitem.headline: US Semiconductor group plans book-to-bill Tuesday.

text.p: The U.S. Semiconductor Industry Association on Monday said it has a target plan to release the September book-to-bill report on Tuesday, Oct 8.

The widely-watched report tallies semiconductor sales and orders received by North American chip makers during the month and calculates a ratio of orders against sales, the so-called book-to-bill ratio.
Analysts generally expect the September book-to-bill ratio to be higher than August's 0.90 ratio.
The SIA plans to release the report after the close of the stock market.
